site.name: Cirata Floating Solar PV
site.location_note: Approximate: these are dam coordinates kept as a placeholder because the array centroid is not published; to be traced from Sentinel-2 imagery.
site.altitude_note: Reservoir full supply level is +220 m; PVGIS terrain data gives 219 m at this point.
site.parties: PT Pembangkitan Jawa Bali Masdar Solar Energi (PMSE): PJBI (PLN Nusantara Power group) 51% / Masdar 49%; offtaker PT PLN (Persero); BOOT, 25-year PPA; EPC PowerChina Huadong

tilt_deg.label: Module tilt (facing north)
tilt_deg.basis: Not public. Fixed tilt confirmed (secondary). 10 deg equator-facing base case; 5-15 deg tested in the sensitivity chart.

gcr.label: Ground coverage ratio (row spacing)
gcr.basis: Row spacing not public. Higher GCR means more row-to-row shading.

row_width_m.label: Row width (module slant length)
row_width_m.basis: Sets row pitch together with GCR; layout not public.

height_m.label: Module height above water
height_m.basis: 1:1 modular HDPE float per module; exact height not public.

albedo.label: Water/float albedo
albedo.basis: Affects ground-reflected light on the front side.

bifacial_gain.label: Bifacial rear-side gain
bifacial_gain.basis: Modules are bifacial (datasheet bifaciality 80 +/- 5%), but water reflects little; plant-specific gain not public.

u_value.label: Cell heat-loss coefficient Uc (cooling)
u_value.basis: Cirata U-value not public. PVsyst free-standing default is about 29; FPV field studies are higher.

soiling.label: Soiling loss
soiling.basis: Likely higher in the Jul-Oct dry season; modelled as an annual constant.

mismatch_wiring.label: Mismatch, DC wiring and wave motion
mismatch_wiring.basis: Typical design-tool defaults widened for float movement.

degradation.label: Annual degradation after year 1
degradation.basis: Jinko warranty: 0.40%/yr linear to 87.4% at year 30.

humidity_degradation.label: Extra degradation from humid over-water environment
humidity_degradation.basis: No reliable published value; placeholder range. Negligible in operating year 1.

inverter_eff.label: Inverter nominal efficiency
inverter_eff.basis: Inverter make/model not public; typical central inverter range.

ac_loss.label: AC loss to export point (600 V to 20 kV to 150 kV)
ac_loss.basis: Transformer and cable losses not public.

availability.label: Availability (uptime)
availability.basis: Not public. Only qualitative fault history (20 kV cable terminations, ground faults). Curtailment not modelled.

economics.capex_note: Rp1.7 trillion (official remarks); US$129M (Jakarta Post 2020, IPB thesis); US$143M (Listrik Indonesia). Unverified.
economics.household_note: ESDM 2024: PLN household sales 130,433,102 MWh / 85,844,540 electrified households.
economics.emission_note: Official Jamali combined-margin factor not confirmed: Kepmen ESDM 163.K/HK.02/MEM.S/2021 exists, appendix not verified.
economics.ugm_bpp_note: UGM: production cost 1.25 US cents/kWh below BPP, implying BPP about 7.1 c/kWh (inference).
not_public: Debt terms (reported US$114M vs about US$140M)

expansion.label: PLN NP target: 500 MWp by 2030 (plan, not commitment)
Dec 2025: about 700 MWac total (plan, not commitment)

reported.label: Inauguration to June 2024
reported.note: 235 days = 672 MWh/day = 3.50 kWh/kWp/day, annualises to 245 GWh. Gross or net: not stated.

reported.label: Cumulative to mid-Nov 2024
reported.note: 'Mid-November' taken as 15 Nov 2024. Gross or net: not stated.

reported.label: Calendar 2024
reported.note: Single article. Implies 1,453 kWh/kWp, AC capacity factor 21.9%, DC 16.5%. Gross or net: not stated.

reported.label: AGM 2025 figure (probably 2024)
reported.note: Year not stated. Conflicts with 279 GWh by 1.9%. Gross or net: not stated.

claims.label: Capable of 300 GWh/yr
claims.who: PLN NP via Warta Ekonomi / Dunia Energi

ugm_claim: UGM thesis: output 95% of target; PR 'up to 93%' (best month, not annual); +17% PR vs nearby ground PV. The 17% is not a cooling effect (measured FPV cooling gain is 1-6%): it mixes module age, technology and O&M. Shown as a claim only, never a model input.

seasonality_inference.note: Inference: assumes a flat daily rate inside the 158 GWh cumulative figure; Jul-Dec about 27% higher per day.

facts: Peaker, mainly 17:00-22:00; capacity factor about 15-16%; about 1,350 GWh/yr vs 1,428 design
PV exports at 150 kV, hydro at 500 kV
reservoir_facts: Full supply +220 m; units stop below +205 m (about 15 m operating band)
Dry about Jun-Oct, wet about Nov-Apr (inference)
About 100,000 vs ideal about 7,200 (Jul 2026); earlier counts 93,641-120,000 conflict
Water hyacinth; sedimentation, thick silt and steep slopes; water quality 'level three' vs PLN NP 'stable' (conflict); lightning: no Cirata-specific data

hardware_facts: 560 Wp, 342,857 modules ('more than 340,000'); Jinko Tiger Neo bifacial N-type TOPCon, double-glass
49 central x 3,400 kVA (3,125 kW + 2,500 kVAR), 1,500 Vdc in, 600 Vac out; total 153.1 MWac; make/model not public
192 / 153.1 = 1.254 at inverters; 192 / 145 = 1.324 vs export limit. Two clipping stages are modelled.
600 V to 20 kV, onshore 150/20 kV, 150 kV Java-Bali via 3.2 km double circuit
1:1 HDPE float per module (Sungrow TS30M truss, PT60 pontoon), Chandra Asri resin, steel barges for inverters, 2,100 concrete anchors
13 islands, each about 430 m x 230 m; illustrative only (26,374 modules per island derived vs 'over 28,000' reported; 49 inverters / 13 islands is about 3.8, so islands differ)
About 250 ha incl. land (about 200 ha water) of a 6,200 ha reservoir: 4.0% coverage (3.2% water only)
Financial close 2-3 Aug 2021; first grid sync Oct 2023; inaugurated 9 Nov 2023; single phase
